proposals.title: Require provenance and fold-fitted transforms for representation candidates
proposals.claim: A representation audit can flag every candidate with unknown protected-stage provenance or preprocessing fitted beyond its training fold before model selection.
proposals.mechanism: Protects interpretation of mmd_u and de_score by separating learned training features from the fixed evaluator space; candidate-specific scorer refits can change comparisons without improving prediction.
proposals.falsifier: Run synthetic manifests covering contaminated, unknown and clean corpora plus validation-fitted PCA; any unflagged case kills the completeness claim.

evidence.says: Lists PCA, embedding, feature-selection leakage and pretrained contamination as audit targets.
Allows disclosed external resources; excludes protected data even through pretraining.

proposals.title: Compare representations through matched forecasts and support diagnostics
proposals.claim: A matched raw-expression/PCA/AE/pretrained bake-off can reject a claimed latent benefit when reconstruction improves but held-out forecast metrics and rare-state support do not.
proposals.mechanism: Evaluate mmd_u and de_score in the same official space with matched predictors and sampling; support diagnostics expose collapsed rare programs hidden by mean reconstruction error.
proposals.falsifier: Use a released-stage holdout with equal predictors; reject the latent-benefit claim if paired forecast improvement is absent or rare-state recall materially declines.

evidence.says: Proposes raw, PCA and learned representation comparisons, smoothness and reconstruction measures.
Poses downstream benefit question; cited historical experiments are absent, so their numerical claims are not adopted.

evidence.ref: Kedzierska et al., Genome Biology 2025, doi:10.1186/s13059-025-03574-x
evidence.says: Zero-shot scGPT/Geneformer embeddings have limitations versus simple and established baselines; does not test this task.

peer_responses.on: biovalid-r1-1: composition/state validation of representation gains
peer_responses.because: Endorse decomposition; panel-derived markers and frozen labels remain correlated validation. Require eligible embryo holdouts, matched prediction heads and unknown-state handling. Neurl IPS 2026/prompts.md:263–290 supplies no downstream result.

A representation's expression accuracy cannot establish lineage or direct regulation. Separate marker prediction from independent assay corroboration and keep protected-target observations outside selection, per official rules §10.

declined: Adopting a unified pretrained latent on reconstruction or smoothness alone: neither establishes forecast gains, future-state support, assay compatibility or admissible corpus provenance.
